summary: Verified iter 144 bug fix for Enquiry Follow-Up & Status Tracker. Default tab now 'All Open' showing all 56 open enquiries (no longer empty); tab labels include counts from KPIs; 'No follow-up planned' badge appears on rows without next_followup_date; helpful per-tab empty messages present. rca of the issue: Root cause was frontend-only: view state defaulted to 'today' while no enquiry had next_followup_date set, so all bucket-filtered tabs (today/upcoming/overdue) showed empty. Fix (already applied by main agent): default state changed to 'all', tabs reordered with All Open first, per-view EMPTY_MSG map added, no_date badge label 'No follow-up planned' shown for rows without next_followup_date. Verified working end-to-end.
